_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-guidelines.mjs. Entries are {rule, file, symbol, reason}. Start empty; add only by explicit decision.

exceptions.reason: Overrides Node EventEmitter.emit(event, ...args). The positional (event, ...args) signature IS the EventEmitter contract; a destructured object would break every listener and super.emit delegation.

Implements the AcpCapability duck-typed remote-client contract, which lib invokes positionally: client.callTool(name, args, { signal }) (lib/tools/external-capability.mjs:152). The positional shape is the external ACP/MCP client contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
Shell-tool HITL callback; the SDK invokes it positionally (command, args) from the shell approval gate. The positional shape is the shell-tool contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
Generic per-tool HITL callback; the SDK invokes it positionally (name, args, ctx) from the approval gate. The positional shape is the approval contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
Shell-tool HITL callback; the SDK invokes it positionally (command, args) from the shell approval gate. The positional shape is the shell-tool contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
`withApproval({ fn })` is invoked positionally (name, args, ctx) by the approval gate. The positional shape is the approval contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
executeTools approval callback; the SDK invokes it positionally (tool, args, callId). The positional shape is the approval contract (lib/tools/tool-execution.mjs), not an SDK-internal callable.
It is a node:http request handler. The (req, res) signature IS the HTTP server contract; a destructured object would break every http.createServer mount.

Deliberately emits an event name that is NOT in the EVENTS registry to demonstrate the strict emitter's unhandled-event reporting (the example asserts the event surfaces on EVENTS.ERRORS.UNHANDLED). Using a registry name here would defeat the demonstration.
A tool:before / tool:after waterfall hook: HookRegistry.runWaterfall calls every hook positionally as fn(value, ctx). The positional shape is the hook contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
A tool:before / tool:after waterfall hook: HookRegistry.runWaterfall calls every hook positionally as fn(value, ctx). The positional shape is the hook contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
The modern stdio facade mirrors the SDK's Server.setRequestHandler(method, handler) contract. A destructured object would not match what a caller (or the SDK's own factory path) invokes.
It is a node:http request handler. The (req, res) signature IS the HTTP server contract; a destructured object would break every http.createServer mount.

Mirrors the OpenAI SDK's positional create(body, opts) contract that lib/backends/adapters/oai-adapter.mjs invokes (executeVendorRequest). A destructured object would change the vendor surface the adapter and host-injected transports depend on.

Mirrors the Anthropic SDK's positional messages.stream(body, opts) contract that lib/backends/adapters/aai-adapter.mjs invokes (executeVendorRequest). A destructured object would change the vendor surface the adapter and host-injected transports depend on.
Implements the platform fetch(url, init) contract for the local OTLP collector the example injects as the exporter's transport. The positional shape is fetch's, not an SDK-internal callable.
This is the `withApproval({ fn })` callback the SDK invokes positionally (name, args, ctx). The positional shape is the approval contract, not an SDK-internal callable.
